messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident fired: INC-15872 -> service=infra-prod, urgency=high (auto-page).

pagerduty-bot: details: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/15872 - triggered by alert 'inference-latency-spike' from prometheus (ops-prod).

Tom H: ugh, I just got paged, same here. I'm on commute, will try to ack.

Aisha R: I also got a page. This looks like the nightly inference ingest lag alert but why infra-prod service? should've go to inference-prod oncall.

Sasha L: Paging rules look like they routed by alert tag 'team:infra' instead of 'team:inference' - probably a tagging mismatch in the new alarm rule.

Carlos M: Confirming: alert payload shows labels: {service:"inference", team:"infra"} - someone changed the relabeler in alertmanager last night.

Tom H: I acked to stop the noise but we need to re-route new pages. Acked INC-15872 (pager shows me as ack).

incident-bot: INC-15872: ack by Tom H at 4109876552. Escalation timer paused.

Aisha R: Tom - can you escalate to oncall lead for inference if there's any customer impact? I'm checking dashboards.

Tom H: On it. @ops-rotation please confirm who should be contacted for inference-prod.

ops-rotation: current inference-prod oncall rotation is Sasha L (primary) -> Carlos M (secondary) -> Tom H (tertiary).

Sasha L: I'm awake, joining. Seeing 95th pct latency jump across the 8 GPU pool. Errors are 502s for a small subset of requests (~30/min).

Carlos M: Looking at logs, a routing rule in the inference-serving autoscaler started failing healthchecks around 02:12 UTC, which aligns with the pages at 02:13. But alertmanager relabeling pointed to infra-prod service.

Aisha R: That explains wrong service. The immediate mitigation: suppress new pages from PagerDuty for infra-prod while we flip relabeler. Can someone create a temporary maintenance window on infra-prod?

Tom H: I've put INC-15872 on manual hold and requested maintenance on infra-prod service in PagerDuty (maintenance request ID MNT-904).

pagerduty-bot: Maintenance MNT-904 created for infra-prod, duration 30m. New alerts will not auto-page infra-prod.

Sasha L: Thanks. I'll push a revert to alertmanager relabeling: revert commit c9f3be -> will change label 'team' back to 'inference' for alerts from prometheus/inference-rules.

Carlos M: While Sasha reverts, I'll run a one-off reroute command to bind current incident to inference-prod so the right oncall gets the postmortem. Command: `pd incidents reassign INC-15872 --to-service inference-prod`

Tom H: Note: reassign failed with 403 - PD service binding policy denies cross-service reassign for incidents older than 5 minutes. We should do manual update.

Sasha L: I updated alertmanager and restarted the config. Confirmed new alerts show team:inference. Deploy ID: deploy/alertmgr/2026-03-15T02:28Z.

incident-bot: New alert routing change detected: alerts from inference rules will now route to inference-prod.

Carlos M: I manually added Carlos M and Sasha L to the INC-15872 responders (so inference oncall owns the follow-up).

Aisha R: Customer impact check: CS reports 2 customer sessions impacted in the last 10 minutes; severity low, but regression in tail latency. I've contacted the account manager to notify customers.

Tom H: Good call. We should keep a 30-min suppress on infra-prod until alert volume stabilizes. Also create a follow-up PR to add a unit test to alert relabeler to catch team label drift.

Sasha L: Agreed. I'll open the PR: GH: redwood/infra#452 - adds label enforcement + test.

Carlos M: Postmortem checklist: root cause = alert relabel config drift during last night's cleanup; secondary cause = PagerDuty service tag mapping assumed label correctness. Action items: revert change (done), PR for tests (in flight), update PagerDuty mapping to fallback to alert.name parsing, and add a runbook to verify alert label and PD service mapping after changes.

Tom H: I'll own the PagerDuty mapping change - will add fallback logic and a small integration test against staging.

incident-bot: INC-15872 status: acknowledged by inference oncall. Maintenance still active for infra-prod until 02:58 UTC.

Aisha R: Any chance this recurs? we need to prevent pages to wrong teams. Suggest a small alertmanager CI job that runs after config changes.

Sasha L: I'll add a job to CI that simulates the alert and verifies PD routing. Will aim for next week.

Carlos M: For now, I'm going to monitor error rate and KV cache health for the next hour. If anything spikes, ping me directly.

Tom H: Thanks everyone. After stabilization, let's spin up a short postmortem thread in #postmortems and include the PD incident link + timeline.

incident-bot: Incident INC-15872 moved to stable. Final note: incident routed to wrong service due to relabeler change; pages suppressed and rerouted. Follow-up: GH#452 (alertmgr tests), PD mapping fallback, CI integration for alert routing test.

Sasha L: :white_check_mark: Closing the immediate loop - will follow up with PR and postmortem writeup.

Carlos M: thx - logging this in #incidents with the timeline.
